testcase.name: reboot is detected without a boot counter when the clocks disagree
changing the wall clock never changes study time
idle has no readout and no boundary
every fourth round is followed by a long break
skip ends the phase now and starts the next one
pausing immediately after resuming records no empty segment
readout crosses a boundary even before the alarm is handled
late wake-up crosses every boundary at its exact instant
paused sessions survive a reboot untouched
pausing mid-phase keeps the remaining time
commands that do not apply are ignored with a reason
reboot credits time up to the last heartbeat and pauses
without auto-start focus the session waits after a break
pomodoro boundaries before the last heartbeat are replayed on reboot
display ticks land exactly on second boundaries
stopwatch counts only running time and segments add up to the total
heartbeats do not create segments or change totals
